sources.title: Ethics Rules for Employees Leaving Federal Service
sources.research_use_and_limit: Explains that seeking employment can include sending a resume, responding to an approach, or using a headhunter when the prospective employer is known, and describes EPA-specific recusal context. Do not generalize agency-specific procedures or give legal advice.

sources.title: Leaving Government
sources.research_use_and_limit: States that former federal employees may face restrictions on post-government employment activities; direct users to their agency ethics office and applicable rules.

sources.title: SR 23-4: Interagency Guidance on Third-Party Relationships: Risk Management
sources.publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
sources.research_use_and_limit: Applies to Federal Reserve-supervised banking organizations and discusses third-party relationship risk management, including some fintech arrangements. It says the guidance does not impose new requirements; avoid implying it applies to every fintech or jurisdiction.

sources.title: Career Migration: From Banking to Fintech
sources.research_use_and_limit: Directly addresses banking-to-fintech career transitions and discusses transferable skills and impact framing. Evidence that similar content exists, not independent proof of market demand or its statistics.

sources.title: How Offshore Wind Can Benefit from Transferable Skills in Oil and Gas
sources.research_use_and_limit: Identifies offshore operations, HSE, and project management as possible transferable skill areas. Practitioner/editorial source, not independent labor-market demand evidence.

sources.title: Basic Safety Training Standard
sources.research_use_and_limit: Describes training modules including first aid, working at height, manual handling, fire awareness, sea survival, and emergency evacuation/rescue. It does not show that every executive or wind-sector role needs the credential.

sources.title: Oil and Gas to Offshore Wind: How to Make the Career Switch
sources.research_use_and_limit: Directly covers oil-and-gas-to-offshore-wind career transition. Treat its credential and funding assertions as provider claims, not universal requirements.

sources.title: Global Jobs, Industries, and Recruiting Research
sources.research_use_and_limit: Distinguishes taxonomy, career guides, and services; specifically cautions that directory coverage does not prove KOV recruits or provides placement support in every role, industry, or market.
